text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Uooooooohhhhh!! 
Haaaaaaahhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*, *pant*... Gah... so close! But... 
we're finally down to 0.7 seconds!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Let's keep at it! I have to... 
become even faster, too!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"I hear it's already the third day of her 
challenge... Before we knew it, quite a 
crowd has gathered."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Hishi Ama-chan is already a girl polished 
by immense hard work. Honestly, pushing 
beyond this seems pretty harsh, but..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Can she really... pull it off? If this 
ends with 'turns out I couldn't do it 
after all'... isn't that gonna look 
totally uncool...?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, but what if she overcomes it? I 
believe this, too, is a matter of the 
scales."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"(I mean, if she does it... that'd be 
insane. It'd be amazing, but...! What if 
it all ends up being for nothing?)"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"(So then... why can't I tear my eyes 
away...? Because she's trying so 
desperately, with everything she's 
got...!)'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "—Not yet! One more lap!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Just how many times is she gonna run...?! 
Is what's on the other side really... 
really worth that much...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Uoooooooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...!! She did it... She broke it! She 
shaved it down to the target time!"

text_block_list.name: Gallery
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HELL YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"No way...! Insane... She really broke 
right through it..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...S-So cool... Damn it, my heart... it's 
burning... What is this feeling...? Ah! 
That's it..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It feels just like that place. That 
feeling you only get after fighting and 
fighting... and finally seizing 
victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... crap... Remembering it makes my 
nose sting... Because that feeling... that 
joy... there's no way I could ever forget 
it...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Vodka! Were you watching?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hishi Ama-senpai... That was... so 
freakin' cool. ...I... Me too, um...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot... Look at that face you're making. 
...Looks like you finally remembered, huh? 
Why you were giving it your all in the 
first place."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Guhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry! Just like she said, I was a 
total idiot!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is... ridiculously painful, and 
super tough, but... Still...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard because my dream was big 
enough to blow all that away...! 
All for that moment where I could feel, 
'I'm the coolest Umamusume alive!'...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Giving up just because I've hit a losing 
streak is actually so stupid! 
I'm not quitting. I'm gonna break through 
that wall too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Vodka...! Haha... Hahahaha! That's the 
spirit! 
Alright then, we'd better catch up on lost 
time quick!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Vodka. You were called back 
by your dream. 
The 'Shelter Squad' has reconvened. Now 
then, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-chan... was beauty itself... 
Talent, effort, and grit... Ah, truly, 
truly...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I can no longer express that 
beauty myself. 
Ugh...! Uuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you were. 
You were watching, right? My run just now. 
How was it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did it bring you any inspiration? 
Hishi Ama-san's challenge... it was 
incredible, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, everyone. But it's fine now. 
I'm thinking of quitting designing and 
starting a different business instead.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Are you... really okay with that? 
You don't have any lingering regrets about 
being a fashion designer?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Because... nothing comes to mind... 
My passion has completely run dry...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Don't give me that 'because'! 
You're not actually convinced at all, are 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's how it looks to me too...! 
Beauty-san, you really love making 
clothes, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Slumps... are painful. But if you overcome 
it, 
I'm sure something truly wonderful is 
waiting on the other side.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But still...! Even if Hishi Ama-chan could 
do it, someone like me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up. 
I won't give up on 'not letting you give 
up'!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up either. We'll just keep 
getting our revenge over and over, 
until our running finally moves your 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll show you a run that makes you want 
to design racing silks for sure. 
So please, watch us again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now I'm fired up! 
Next up is a one-on-one showdown between 
our running and your heart!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This time, I... we will... 
remind you of it in the coolest way 
possible, just like Hishi Ama-senpai did!
And from that day on...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! How was that?! 
That one felt solid!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
......No good. Nothing's coming to me. 
You're fast, passionate, and beautiful, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Guh! I'm not giving up! 
I'm gonna get past my wall, too. Starting 
with the wall right in front of me: you, 
Beauty-san!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch! 
Next time, I'm gonna blow you away with an 
insanely cool run!
